# Los Angeles Chargers at Baltimore Ravens: Where to Watch, Listen & Live Stream

Nov 12, 2026 at 08:00 AM

Omar Navarro

Jr. Writer

The Los Angeles Chargers hit the road for their first primetime game of the season as they travel to take on the Baltimore Ravens on Monday Night Football.

### MATCHUP HISTORY [...] The matchup will mark the 16th regular-season matchup between the two teams. The Ravens hold an all-time record of 10-5, as they have won each of the last three meetings. It will be just the second Monday Night Football matchup in the series, and the first in Baltimore.

The last regular-season meeting between these two teams came in Week 12 of the 2024 season, a Monday night game at SoFi Stadium.
